name: project-planner
title: Plan a project where the machine, not the model, computes the schedule

origin.source: Project manager assistant (GenAI_Agents community LangGraph tutorial)

comparison.purpose: The model proposes tasks with durations and dependencies; the machine checks the dependency graph (unique ids, known references, no cycles), computes the critical-path schedule itself, has Jev judge the delivery risk of that schedule, and re-plans only when the computed length misses the deadline, with bounded repair and replan budgets that end in failed.

input.goal: Ship a mobile app MVP for iOS and Android

starters.label: Generous 90-day deadline — fits on the first plan

input.goal: Launch a company blog with ten launch posts
